name: spokeagent
description: Structure-aware access to the SPOKE biomedical knowledge graph (Neo4j). Compact live schema, entity/identifier resolution, node profiling, shortest-path finding, and guarded read-only Cypher over diseases, genes, proteins, compounds, pathways and more. Access requires a passcode from UCSF.

skills.name: spoke-knowledge-graph
skills.description: Resolve entities and traverse the SPOKE biomedical knowledge graph (diseases, genes, compounds, proteins, pathways, anatomy, side effects) structure-aware.
